capabilities: scale card text proportionally to each card's rendered size
shrink overflowing cards' text to the largest size that fits
clamp font sizes with base, min, max, and sensitivity settings
skip cards whose font-size is already styled by a theme or snippet
extras: Manual installation only until accepted into the community plugin directory. Deliberately sets inline styles with !important on card text because no stylesheet rule can beat Canvas's zoom-compensation; a 'Respect existing font-size CSS' toggle and a master off switch clear or avoid overrides. The store listing notes the plugin has not been reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: instead of only scaling with canvas zoom
motivation: The author first tried to achieve this with CSS in the Rathgar Gold theme; both container-query attempts failed due to Canvas internals, so they built a plugin around a proven JavaScript technique.
problem: Obsidian Canvas scales card text only with zoom level, so enlarging a card does not enlarge its text and overflowing cards scroll instead of fitting.
summary: Canvas enhancer that scales the text inside each Canvas card proportionally to the card's own size as you resize it, instead of only scaling with canvas zoom.
